result:
I’d make it impossible for anyone to see other people as abstractions.

Not by force — but by changing the underlying machinery of perception, so that when you look at someone different from you, you can’t help but feel the texture of their inner life: their worries, their loves, their reasons. You wouldn’t have to agree with them, but you couldn’t dismiss them as cardboard characters in your story. They’d be as real to you as you are to yourself.

Most of the world’s cruelty, I think, runs on the comfortable distance of not really believing the other person is fully conscious. Take that away, and war, exploitation, and indifference would become very hard to sustain.
